Get the PXWEB API catalogue

Source: R/pxweb_api_catalogue.R
pxweb_api_catalogue.Rd

Get the PXWEB API catalogue

Usage

pxweb_api_catalogue()

pxweb_api_catalogue_from_json(json)

pxweb_api_catalogue_from_github(branch = "master")

pxweb_api_catalogue_path()

Details

A list with implemented API:s.

Examples

pxweb_api_catalogue()
#> $api.scb.se
#> Api: api.scb.se
#>      Statistics Sweden 
#>      ('scb')
#> Version(s)   : v1 
#> Language(s)  : en, sv 
#> Url template :
